items.name: 利用开环频域指标估算时域性能方法
items.definition: 通过相角裕度γ和截止频率ω_c估算系统时域性能指标。

items.name: 衰减曲线法
items.definition: 使系统阶跃响应产生衰减振荡，再根据衰减振荡曲线的参数来确定PID参数的方法。

items.name: 根轨迹
items.definition: 根轨迹：The locus of roots of the characteristic equation in the s-plane as a parameter is varied.。

items.name: negative gain root locus
items.definition: negative gain root locus：A root locus plotted for negative values of the gain parameter K, also referred to as a 0° root locus.

items.name: Determining GM from root locus
items.definition: Determining GM from root locus：Determining GM from root locus
